en: Black‑and‑white interior view of a chapel with wooden pews and a central aisle leading toward a doorway under a dark wooden gallery or organ loft. Statues of religious figures are set into wall niches on both sides, surrounded by decorative painted cartouches with inscriptions. The lower left corner bears a printed caption in Swedish, and the lower right has a small oval publisher's mark.
